why: Contested. WIRED's main 3-in-1 guide says it tested 30+ stands and puts prices near the budget, but the text we can see doesn't show whether its picks are Qi2.2. WIRED's travel guide and Good Housekeeping each answer only part of the question. Almost everything else is one-product pages: Macworld, Cult of Mac and 9to5Mac reviews, deal posts, and many duplicate ESR and Kuxiu store pages. knowledgelib is the only page that lists Qi2.2 25W picks with prices, and it's an untested aggregator. A focused page limited to Qi2.2 stands under $120 could get in, but it would be up against WIRED's tested roundup.
